not_measured.raw_llm_arm: requires an API key (forge/llm.py); random_tiles is the no-LLM stand-in

not_measured.cross_version_reliability: only one game version analysed; `agent1_blueprint.py --check` detects source drift but no second version was benchmarked
not_measured.difficulty_vs_human_playtest: no playtesting; difficulty is the blueprint's own score (trap pressure, dead-state ratio, rule changes, sacrificed words), which has not been compared with human ratings
